rules.sql: SELECT 'valuation_date_table (tenant, bu)' AS input, count(*) AS row_count, count(DISTINCT business_unit) AS distinct_key FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant
SELECT 'cloned_underlying_list_table (underlying_id)' AS input, count(*) AS row_count, count(DISTINCT underlying_id) AS distinct_key FROM opera.cloned_underlying_list_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant
SELECT 'product_master_table (invenio_product_code)' AS input, count(*) AS row_count, count(DISTINCT invenio_product_code) AS distinct_key FROM opera.product_master_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant

SELECT 'curr_mult_view (bu, product, value_date)' AS input, count(*) AS row_count, count(DISTINCT business_unit || '|' || invenio_product_code || '|' || value_date) AS distinct_key FROM opera.curr_mult_view WHERE tenant_id = :tenant

SELECT 'cloned_curr_mult_view (bu, product, value_date)' AS input, count(*) AS row_count, count(DISTINCT business_unit || '|' || invenio_product_code || '|' || value_date) AS distinct_key FROM opera.cloned_curr_mult_view WHERE tenant_id = :tenant

SELECT 'murex_nc_factor_view (bu, product, value_date)' AS input, count(*) AS row_count, count(DISTINCT business_unit || '|' || invenio_product_code || '|' || value_date) AS distinct_key FROM opera.murex_nc_factor_view WHERE tenant_id = :tenant

SELECT 'security_info_table (bu, security_id)' AS input, count(*) AS row_count, count(DISTINCT business_unit || '|' || security_id) AS distinct_key FROM opera.security_info_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant

SELECT 'helper_invenio_product_code (bu, security_id)' AS input, count(*) AS row_count, count(DISTINCT business_unit || '|' || security_id) AS distinct_key FROM opera.helper_invenio_product_code WHERE tenant_id = :tenant
SELECT 'fixing_table (bu, trade_id)' AS input, count(*) AS row_count, count(DISTINCT business_unit || '|' || trade_id) AS distinct_key FROM opera.fixing_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant

SELECT 'underlying_settle_value_table (underlying_id, value_date)' AS input, count(*) AS row_count, count(DISTINCT underlying_id || '|' || value_date) AS distinct_key FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant

SELECT 'underlying_actual_value_table (underlying_id, value_date)' AS input, count(*) AS row_count, count(DISTINCT underlying_id || '|' || value_date) AS distinct_key FROM opera.underlying_actual_value_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant

SELECT 'sp-1 cloned_security_info_table' AS stage, count(*) AS row_count, count(DISTINCT s.business_unit || '|' || s.security_id) AS distinct_security FROM opera.cloned_security_info_table s WHERE s.tenant_id = :tenant

SELECT 'sp-2 + valuation_date_table' AS stage, count(*) AS row_count, count(DISTINCT s.business_unit || '|' || s.security_id) AS distinct_security FROM opera.cloned_security_info_table s JOIN opera.valuation_date_table v ON v.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND v.business_unit = s.business_unit WHERE s.tenant_id = :tenant

SELECT 'sp-3 + underlying lists u1 u2' AS stage, count(*) AS row_count, count(DISTINCT s.business_unit || '|' || s.security_id) AS distinct_security FROM opera.cloned_security_info_table s JOIN opera.valuation_date_table v ON v.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND v.business_unit = s.business_unit LEFT JOIN opera.cloned_underlying_list_table u1 ON u1.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND u1.underlying_id = s.underlying1_id LEFT JOIN opera.cloned_underlying_list_table u2 ON u2.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND u2.underlying_id = s.underlying2_id WHERE s.tenant_id = :tenant

SELECT 'sp-4 + curr_mult_view cm1' AS stage, count(*) AS row_count, count(DISTINCT s.business_unit || '|' || s.security_id) AS distinct_security FROM opera.cloned_security_info_table s JOIN opera.valuation_date_table v ON v.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND v.business_unit = s.business_unit LEFT JOIN opera.cloned_underlying_list_table u1 ON u1.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND u1.underlying_id = s.underlying1_id LEFT JOIN opera.cloned_underlying_list_table u2 ON u2.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND u2.underlying_id = s.underlying2_id LEFT JOIN opera.curr_mult_view cm1 ON cm1.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND cm1.business_unit = s.business_unit AND cm1.invenio_product_code = s.product_code AND cm1.value_date = v.value_date WHERE s.tenant_id = :tenant

SELECT 'sp-5 + product_master_table pm1' AS stage, count(*) AS row_count, count(DISTINCT s.business_unit || '|' || s.security_id) AS distinct_security FROM opera.cloned_security_info_table s JOIN opera.valuation_date_table v ON v.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND v.business_unit = s.business_unit LEFT JOIN opera.cloned_underlying_list_table u1 ON u1.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND u1.underlying_id = s.underlying1_id LEFT JOIN opera.cloned_underlying_list_table u2 ON u2.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND u2.underlying_id = s.underlying2_id LEFT JOIN opera.curr_mult_view cm1 ON cm1.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND cm1.business_unit = s.business_unit AND cm1.invenio_product_code = s.product_code AND cm1.value_date = v.value_date LEFT JOIN opera.product_master_table pm1 ON pm1.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND pm1.invenio_product_code = s.product_code WHERE s.tenant_id = :tenant

SELECT 'sp-6 + cloned_curr_mult_view cm2' AS stage, count(*) AS row_count, count(DISTINCT s.business_unit || '|' || s.security_id) AS distinct_security FROM opera.cloned_security_info_table s JOIN opera.valuation_date_table v ON v.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND v.business_unit = s.business_unit LEFT JOIN opera.cloned_underlying_list_table u1 ON u1.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND u1.underlying_id = s.underlying1_id LEFT JOIN opera.cloned_underlying_list_table u2 ON u2.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND u2.underlying_id = s.underlying2_id LEFT JOIN opera.curr_mult_view cm1 ON cm1.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND cm1.business_unit = s.business_unit AND cm1.invenio_product_code = s.product_code AND cm1.value_date = v.value_date LEFT JOIN opera.product_master_table pm1 ON pm1.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND pm1.invenio_product_code = s.product_code LEFT JOIN opera.cloned_curr_mult_view cm2 ON cm2.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND cm2.business_unit = s.business_unit AND cm2.invenio_product_code = u2.invenio_product_code AND cm2.value_date = v.value_date WHERE s.tenant_id = :tenant

SELECT 'sp-7 + cloned_product_master_table pm2' AS stage, count(*) AS row_count, count(DISTINCT s.business_unit || '|' || s.security_id) AS distinct_security FROM opera.cloned_security_info_table s JOIN opera.valuation_date_table v ON v.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND v.business_unit = s.business_unit LEFT JOIN opera.cloned_underlying_list_table u1 ON u1.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND u1.underlying_id = s.underlying1_id LEFT JOIN opera.cloned_underlying_list_table u2 ON u2.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND u2.underlying_id = s.underlying2_id LEFT JOIN opera.curr_mult_view cm1 ON cm1.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND cm1.business_unit = s.business_unit AND cm1.invenio_product_code = s.product_code AND cm1.value_date = v.value_date LEFT JOIN opera.product_master_table pm1 ON pm1.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND pm1.invenio_product_code = s.product_code LEFT JOIN opera.cloned_curr_mult_view cm2 ON cm2.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND cm2.business_unit = s.business_unit AND cm2.invenio_product_code = u2.invenio_product_code AND cm2.value_date = v.value_date LEFT JOIN opera.cloned_product_master_table pm2 ON pm2.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND pm2.invenio_product_code = u2.invenio_product_code WHERE s.tenant_id = :tenant

SELECT 'sp-8 + murex_nc_factor_view mx' AS stage, count(*) AS row_count, count(DISTINCT s.business_unit || '|' || s.security_id) AS distinct_security FROM opera.cloned_security_info_table s JOIN opera.valuation_date_table v ON v.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND v.business_unit = s.business_unit LEFT JOIN opera.cloned_underlying_list_table u1 ON u1.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND u1.underlying_id = s.underlying1_id LEFT JOIN opera.cloned_underlying_list_table u2 ON u2.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND u2.underlying_id = s.underlying2_id LEFT JOIN opera.curr_mult_view cm1 ON cm1.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND cm1.business_unit = s.business_unit AND cm1.invenio_product_code = s.product_code AND cm1.value_date = v.value_date LEFT JOIN opera.product_master_table pm1 ON pm1.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND pm1.invenio_product_code = s.product_code LEFT JOIN opera.cloned_curr_mult_view cm2 ON cm2.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND cm2.business_unit = s.business_unit AND cm2.invenio_product_code = u2.invenio_product_code AND cm2.value_date = v.value_date LEFT JOIN opera.cloned_product_master_table pm2 ON pm2.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND pm2.invenio_product_code = u2.invenio_product_code LEFT JOIN opera.murex_nc_factor_view mx ON mx.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND mx.business_unit = s.business_unit AND mx.invenio_product_code = s.product_code AND mx.value_date = v.value_date WHERE s.tenant_id = :tenant

SELECT 'fx-1 drv' AS stage, count(*) AS row_count, count(DISTINCT d.business_unit || '|' || d.trade_id) AS distinct_trade FROM ( SELECT tenant_id, business_unit, trade_id, security_id FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND lower(business_unit) IN ('bkr', 'ebo', 'gpc', 'grn', 'og2', 'ogp', 'rba', 'rbc', 'stg', 'tsy', 'usg') UNION ALL SELECT tenant_id, business_unit, trade_id, security_id FROM opera.deal_ticket_table_with_fy_premium_view WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND lower(business_unit) IN ('cfs', 'rov', 'cto', 'orm', 'osg', 'rmc') ) d

SELECT 'fx-3 + security_info_table' AS stage, count(*) AS row_count, count(DISTINCT d.business_unit || '|' || d.trade_id) AS distinct_trade FROM ( SELECT tenant_id, business_unit, trade_id, security_id FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND lower(business_unit) IN ('bkr', 'ebo', 'gpc', 'grn', 'og2', 'ogp', 'rba', 'rbc', 'stg', 'tsy', 'usg') UNION ALL SELECT tenant_id, business_unit, trade_id, security_id FROM opera.deal_ticket_table_with_fy_premium_view WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND lower(business_unit) IN ('cfs', 'rov', 'cto', 'orm', 'osg', 'rmc') ) d JOIN opera.valuation_date_table v ON v.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND v.business_unit = d.business_unit LEFT JOIN opera.security_info_table si ON si.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND si.business_unit = d.business_unit AND si.security_id = d.security_id

SELECT 'fx-6 + fixing_table' AS stage, count(*) AS row_count, count(DISTINCT d.business_unit || '|' || d.trade_id) AS distinct_trade FROM ( SELECT tenant_id, business_unit, trade_id, security_id FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND lower(business_unit) IN ('bkr', 'ebo', 'gpc', 'grn', 'og2', 'ogp', 'rba', 'rbc', 'stg', 'tsy', 'usg') UNION ALL SELECT tenant_id, business_unit, trade_id, security_id FROM opera.deal_ticket_table_with_fy_premium_view WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND lower(business_unit) IN ('cfs', 'rov', 'cto', 'orm', 'osg', 'rmc') ) d JOIN opera.valuation_date_table v ON v.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND v.business_unit = d.business_unit LEFT JOIN opera.security_info_table si ON si.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND si.business_unit = d.business_unit AND si.security_id = d.security_id LEFT JOIN opera.helper_invenio_product_code hipc ON hipc.tenant_id = si.tenant_id AND hipc.business_unit = si.business_unit AND hipc.security_id = si.security_id LEFT JOIN opera.product_master_table pm ON pm.tenant_id = si.tenant_id AND pm.invenio_product_code = hipc.invenio_product_code LEFT JOIN opera.fixing_table ft ON ft.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND ft.business_unit = d.business_unit AND ft.trade_id = d.trade_id

SELECT 'fx-7 + settle value by curr_mult_factor' AS stage, count(*) AS row_count, count(DISTINCT d.business_unit || '|' || d.trade_id) AS distinct_trade FROM ( SELECT tenant_id, business_unit, trade_id, security_id FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND lower(business_unit) IN ('bkr', 'ebo', 'gpc', 'grn', 'og2', 'ogp', 'rba', 'rbc', 'stg', 'tsy', 'usg') UNION ALL SELECT tenant_id, business_unit, trade_id, security_id FROM opera.deal_ticket_table_with_fy_premium_view WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND lower(business_unit) IN ('cfs', 'rov', 'cto', 'orm', 'osg', 'rmc') ) d JOIN opera.valuation_date_table v ON v.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND v.business_unit = d.business_unit LEFT JOIN opera.security_info_table si ON si.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND si.business_unit = d.business_unit AND si.security_id = d.security_id LEFT JOIN opera.helper_invenio_product_code hipc ON hipc.tenant_id = si.tenant_id AND hipc.business_unit = si.business_unit AND hipc.security_id = si.security_id LEFT JOIN opera.product_master_table pm ON pm.tenant_id = si.tenant_id AND pm.invenio_product_code = hipc.invenio_product_code LEFT JOIN opera.fixing_table ft ON ft.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND ft.business_unit = d.business_unit AND ft.trade_id = d.trade_id LEFT JOIN opera.underlying_settle_value_table usv_cm ON usv_cm.tenant_id = pm.tenant_id AND usv_cm.underlying_id = pm.curr_mult_factor AND usv_cm.value_date = v.value_date
